panels.title: Trinidad Wakes
panels.actionBeat: Kai moves through a waking Trinidad street toward the doubles cart. Traffic rhythm and street sound subtly pull toward Kai without him noticing. Kai reaches the cart, still unaware the rhythm has selected him.

panels.title: Doubles Before Destiny
panels.actionBeat: Kai reaches for doubles. A gold pulse snaps under his sneaker and interrupts the joke. Kai freezes, focus replacing hunger.

panels.title: Mother Lall's Warning
panels.actionBeat: Mother Lall folds a coded sigil into a wrapper. Spoon taps with impossible timing. Her eyes warn Kai before the adults explain anything.

panels.title: Asha Reads The Wall
panels.actionBeat: Slow push from cracked wall mark to Asha's eye; teal memory shimmer rolls through paint.

panels.title: The Listening Bois
panels.actionBeat: Kai reaches into hidden storage. The Listening Bois wakes and pulls rhythm into his palm. Kai recoils as the gayelle threshold forms.

panels.title: First Pulse Knockback
panels.actionBeat: Kai loses balance as the staff rolls toward him. Ground ring launches him backward. His hand catches the staff by instinct.

panels.title: Street Becomes Gayelle
panels.actionBeat: 360 camera move as street phases into ancestral gayelle circle.

panels.title: Nia Breaks Fear
panels.actionBeat: Nia inhales while fear static closes in. She shouts a lavway command that breaks the wave. Gold sound ribbons clear space around the heroes.

panels.title: Mother Lall Blocks Silence
panels.actionBeat: Black silence slash enters from offscreen. Mother Lall intercepts it with a serving spoon. She holds the block with a calm glare.

panels.title: Marius Removes Sound
panels.actionBeat: Locked dread shot; black pulse expands and absorbs gold rhythm.

panels.title: Selah Watches
panels.actionBeat: Rooftop wind; baton tilts; Selah's eyes narrow.

panels.title: Kai vs Malik Exchange
panels.narration: A drum has rhythm A lavway
panels.actionBeat: Malik steps in with precise red/black Rhythm Break strike. Kai blocks with accidental gold Tempo Pulse and stumbles into a low sweep. Both fighters separate with Papa's cane about to interrupt.

panels.title: Papa Stops Them
panels.actionBeat: Cane hits ground; root pulse freezes both fighters; Guardian mark opens.

panels.title: Jabs Posts The Rumor
panels.actionBeat: Phone glow pulses; Jabs panics; rhythm static suggests the clip spread without showing readable text.

panels.title: Tobago Answers
panels.actionBeat: Tariq plants Tidewatch staff; sea-blue tide marks glow across sand.

panels.title: Stillwater Command
panels.actionBeat: Marius raises the silence staff. Black pulse absorbs surrounding rhythm. Stillwater silhouettes kneel without readable symbols.

panels.title: Final Cliffhanger
panels.narration: rest of the islands will answer
panels.actionBeat: Marius' stillness collapses sound. Kai hears the impossible silent drumbeat. Gold/sea-blue pulse answers black ring on unresolved stare.
